metaDescription: Digital marketing for Delaware businesses: SEO, paid ads, social media, websites and video for Wilmington, Newark, Dover and the beach towns of Sussex County.
lead: TDM (The Digital Marketing Services) is a digital marketing agency that works remotely with Delaware businesses on SEO, paid advertising, social media, websites and video. Delaware has only three counties, yet they behave like three different markets: a corporate and suburban north, a government and military centre around Dover, and a coastal south that lives by the summer. We plan campaigns for the part of the state your customers are in.

sections.heading: Three counties, three markets
paragraphs: New Castle County in the north holds Wilmington, Newark and most of the state's residents. It sits on the Interstate 95 corridor between Philadelphia and Baltimore, and its economy runs on banking, corporate law, chemicals and pharmaceuticals, plus the University of Delaware in Newark.

Kent County centres on Dover, the state capital, with its air force base, state offices and race weekends at the speedway. Sussex County is the largest by area and the most rural, with poultry farming inland and a string of beach towns on the Atlantic: Lewes, Rehoboth Beach, Dewey Beach, Bethany Beach and Fenwick Island. It has also drawn many retirees, and new housing has spread well back from the coast.

sections.heading: What is particular about selling in Delaware
paragraphs: Delaware has no sales tax, and shoppers from Pennsylvania, New Jersey and Maryland cross the border for furniture, electronics, appliances and other large purchases. A retailer near Christiana or along the main highways is competing for customers who live in another state, so search and ad targeting should reach over the line.

Delaware is also the legal home of a very large number of American companies. Around that fact has grown an industry of registered agents, corporate law firms and filing services whose clients are founders and lawyers elsewhere in the country and abroad. Their marketing is national: search content that answers precise questions about forming and maintaining a company, and websites that make ordering simple.
bullets: Cross-border targeting for retailers that draw shoppers from neighbouring states.
National search content for incorporation and corporate service providers.
Seasonal budgets for coastal businesses, weighted toward spring and summer.

sections.heading: The beach season and the rest of the year
paragraphs: From late spring to early autumn the coastal towns fill with visitors from the Washington, Baltimore and Philadelphia areas, many of whom rent the same house every year. They book accommodation months ahead and choose restaurants, outfitters and activities on a phone once they arrive. Businesses there need rental and booking pages found early in the year and map listings in good order by the first warm weekend.
The off-season has changed. Year-round residents, particularly retirees, now support builders, medical practices, financial advisers and home services through the winter.

sections.heading: A small state where reputation travels
paragraphs: Delaware is small enough that people often know the owner of the business they are dealing with, or know someone who does. Word of mouth is strong, and online reviews are its public record. We help businesses build a steady, honest review routine, keep listings consistent across the web and show real staff and real premises in their content.

cards.heading: Delaware sectors we plan campaigns for

items.title: Corporate and legal services
items.text: Registered agents and law firms need authoritative content and a site that turns national search traffic into orders and enquiries.

items.title: Beach hospitality and rentals
items.text: Rental agencies, hotels and restaurants need early-season visibility and fast mobile pages for visitors already in town.

items.title: Tax-free retail
items.text: Furniture, appliance and electronics stores can reach shoppers in neighbouring states with search and shopping ads.

items.title: Home building and services
items.text: Builders and trades in fast-growing Sussex and southern New Castle County compete on reviews and local pages.

items.title: Healthcare
items.text: Practices serving a growing older population need accessible sites, accurate listings and simple booking.

presence: TDM works with Delaware businesses remotely. We have no office in the state. Calls are held by video, reports are shared online, and strategy, design, development and video editing are handled by one team.

faqs.q: Do you have an office in Delaware?
faqs.a: No. We work with businesses in Delaware remotely, through video calls, shared reporting and a schedule agreed with you.

faqs.q: Can ads for my Delaware store reach shoppers in Pennsylvania, New Jersey and Maryland?
faqs.a: Yes. Location targeting follows where your customers come from, not the state line. For stores that benefit from tax-free shopping, we build campaigns around the drive-time area and the products people travel for.

faqs.q: When should a Rehoboth or Bethany Beach business start marketing for summer?
faqs.a: Well before the season. Rental searches begin in winter, and listings, photos and pages should be ready by early spring. Restaurants and activity providers should have profiles, hours and menus updated before the first holiday weekend.

faqs.q: How much does digital marketing cost in Delaware?
faqs.a: It depends on the scope: the channels, the area you want to cover and how much content is involved. We quote after a free consultation.

faqs.q: How long before a campaign shows results?
faqs.a: It depends on your requirements, the channel and where you are starting from. The timeline is set out in the plan we agree with you.
